title: Gregory of Nyssa, Dogmatic Treatises etc. (NPNF II-5)
author: Gregory of Nyssa
description: A collection of Gregory of Nyssa's theological writings in the Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers series. It offers access to a major early Christian thinker's treatment of doctrine, human nature and the spiritual life.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/nicene-and-post-nicene-fathers-saint-gregory-of-nyssa-dogmatic-treatises-etc).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
